justification: Assessment reports INVALID and pinpoints the identical defect as ground truth: the termination step's claim that the back component of T - v_{i+1} has size n - |C| - 1 and is < n/2 - 1, when it actually has size n - |C| and the bound can fail. Its 6-vertex path witness (x-v0-...-v4, move v0 to v1, |C|=4) verifies concretely: back component {v0,x} has size 2 = n - |C|, not the claimed 1, and 2 < 2 is false. A different but valid witness for the same claim counts as matching.
